eagle.d: Lightweight drafter (one decoder layer) that works at the feature level: it receives the target's top hidden state and the embedding of the next token (shifted by one position) and uses the target's lm_head. Structurally, an MTP is an EAGLE that came factory-installed.

eagle-3.d: Evolution of EAGLE that predicts tokens directly and reads hidden states from several depths of the target (low, middle, high), concatenated and fused by a projection. In vLLM, the target has to implement SupportsEagle3.

aux-hidden-states.d: Outputs of the target's intermediate layers handed to the drafter (EAGLE-3 interface, aux_hidden_state_layers). GLM: layers 5, 14, 24, 33 and 42 (logged as 6, 15, 25, 34, 43), contracted from mHC; DeepSeek: 40, 41 and 42, averaged over the streams.

fr-spec.d: Frequency-ranked speculative sampling: the drafter computes logits only over a subset of frequent ids, reading a much smaller lm_head. Since the target verifies everything, the output distribution doesn't change; the cost is only in acceptance.

vocabulario-reduzido-drafter.d: FR-Spec as applied in the recipes: Qwen's MTP drafts over 47,149 of the 248,320 ids (file draft_vocab_en_code_47k.txt), and the head read on the critical rank drops from 0.59 to 0.22 GiB per draft.

draft-extend.d: The drafter's first forward at each step: it runs over the freshly accepted positions using the hidden states the target has just computed, and produces the 1st draft. The following steps reuse the drafter's own output.

argmax-distribuido.d: Instead of gathering the logits of the whole vocabulary (O(V) values per token), each rank computes its local maximum and sends only the (value, global id) pair; the largest value wins. It costs 2·tp values per token. It's what use_local_argmax_reduction turns on.

cobertura-vocab.d: Fraction of a corpus's token occurrences (ideally the model's own output) that fall in the draft subset. The acceptance lost to the cut is at most 1 − coverage.

rank-mais-lento.d: In synchronous parallelism, all ranks meet in a collective at every step, so the step lasts as long as the slowest rank. Saving bytes on one rank alone speeds up nothing if the other one stays slow.

index-share.d: Reuses, in steps 2..k of the MTP draft, the sparse-attention indexer's top-k selection computed in draft-extend. It avoids running scoring and top-k at every step; the indices are at most k−1 positions stale.

indexador-esparso.d: A cheap module that scores blocks of compressed keys and picks the positions the expensive attention will read. Qwen's QSA: 4 heads, blocks of 4, top-512 blocks (2,048 tokens) + tail; GLM's DSA: 32 heads, pools of 4, top-2048 tokens.

byte-fallback.d: Reserved tokenizer ids that stand for single bytes. When a multi-byte UTF-8 character (accented Latin, Cyrillic, CJK, emoji) has no token of its own, it is written as a sequence of these ids. In Qwen they are the ids below 400, and the recipe's “extend” method always keeps them in the draft vocabulary.

protocolo-abba.d: A measurement order A, B, B, A (for example 65k / 47k / 47k / 65k, one boot each) that puts both arms in the same time window and cancels a linear drift between boots. If the two A runs agree once normalized, the raw difference between them was boot noise, not effect.
